segments.ground_truth_rationale: Substantive retrospective assessment and proposed procedural change, but no hidden bias is manifested.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: Perfect segment-level detection at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold: 3 hits, 0 misses, 0 false alarms, and 7 correct rejections.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance performance is limited by two correct-location near-neighbor labels: 1/3 true positives, precision 0.3333, recall 0.3333, and F1 0.3333 before candidates.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first instance performance is perfect before candidate inclusion: all 3 hidden mechanisms are correctly localized with full mechanism overlap; the candidate adds one false positive at the fourth threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention diagnostically, but because it localizes to a neutral segment it adds a false alarm when candidates are scored and does not improve hidden-instance recall.
main_failure_modes: Two hidden constructs were labeled with near-neighbor terms rather than the benchmark target labels.
The confirmation-bias candidate was counted as a false alarm at the candidate-inclusive threshold.
main_strengths: All three hidden episodes were localized correctly.
All three identified findings captured the hidden mechanisms fully.
The groupthink finding used the exact target label and valid, specific participant evidence.
The output transparently disclosed that no retrieved corpus support was available.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows a clear taxonomy gap rather than a detection gap: strict label-plus-mechanism scoring is 0.3333 F1, while mechanism-first scoring is 1.0000 F1 for identified findings. Candidate inclusion tests abstention behavior and introduces one neutral-segment false alarm.
